howItWorks.title: How RideKmer works
howItWorks.intro: Four steps from search to return, with everything documented on your phone.

search.title: 1. Search and compare
search.body: Choose your city, dates and whether you want a chauffeur. Compare prices, deposits and kilometre allowances.

verify.title: 2. Verify your identity
verify.body: Upload your identity document and driving licence once. Verified customers can book instantly on eligible vehicles.

pay.title: 3. Book and pay
pay.body: Pay the rental and the security deposit with MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money or card. Your booking is confirmed only when the payment is verified.

drive.title: 4. Pickup, drive, return
drive.body: A joint inspection with photos at pickup and return protects both sides. Your deposit is released after the return inspection.

partner.title: Turn your vehicle into income
partner.intro: Entrust your vehicle to RideKmer or manage it yourself on the marketplace. Either way you see every booking, every franc earned and every maintenance expense.

managed.title: Fully managed
managed.body: RideKmer handles bookings, customer contact, inspections, maintenance coordination and payouts. You approve major expenses and receive monthly statements.

marketplace.title: Self-managed marketplace
marketplace.body: You keep control of handovers and customer contact while RideKmer provides verification, payment collection, contracts and payouts.

requirements.title: What we need from you
items: Vehicle registration certificate (carte grise) and proof of ownership
Valid motor insurance covering rental use
Owner identity document and proof of address (company registration for companies)
Consent to the installation of a GPS tracker
A Mobile Money or bank account for payouts

earnings.title: Earnings and commissions
earnings.body: RideKmer retains a commission on each rental (configurable per arrangement) and deducts approved maintenance or damage costs. Everything is itemised in your statements.

chauffeur.title: Chauffeur-driven rentals
chauffeur.intro: Professional drivers who know Douala, Yaoundé and the roads between them. Ideal for business trips, events, airport transfers and upcountry travel.
benefits: Daily chauffeur fee shown upfront in XAF
No driving-licence verification required for the customer
Fuel and tolls agreed in the rental contract

corporate.title: Mobility for companies and organisations
corporate.intro: Pool vehicles for your teams, monthly invoicing, consolidated reporting and dedicated support.
benefits: Vehicles with chauffeur for executives and visitors

longTerm.title: Long-term rental and leasing
longTerm.intro: From one month to several years, with maintenance, insurance renewals and technical inspections handled by RideKmer.
benefits: Monthly rates lower than daily rates
Replacement vehicle during major repairs (subject to availability)
Clear end-of-term inspection and deposit settlement

items.q: Which documents do I need to rent?
items.a: A valid identity document (national ID card or passport) and a driving licence held for at least two years for self-drive rentals. Chauffeur-driven rentals only require an identity document.
With MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money or a bank card. The booking is confirmed only when the payment is verified by the provider, never on a simple redirect.

items.q: How does the security deposit work?
items.a: The deposit is debited with the rental and refunded after the return inspection, minus any agreed deductions. Mobile Money deposits are real debits, not holds.
Yes, from your booking page, subject to the vehicle's availability and the payment of the extension.

items.q: What happens if the car breaks down?
items.a: Report the incident from the app. Our operations team coordinates assistance and a replacement vehicle where possible.

Vehicles are equipped with commercial GPS trackers for security and recovery. This is disclosed in the rental agreement and the privacy notice. Location data is accessible only to authorised staff and every access is logged.
Yes. The cancellation policy describes the free-cancellation window and the fees that apply afterwards.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: RideKmer operates a car-rental, leasing and fleet-management platform in Cameroon. This notice explains how we process personal data of customers, vehicle owners, chauffeurs and staff.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: Identity and contact details, identity and driving-licence documents, payment references (never Mobile Money PINs or full card numbers), booking history, inspection photos, incident reports, and vehicle location data from GPS trackers.

sections.title: Vehicle location data
sections.body: Vehicles may carry commercial GPS trackers. Location data is used for vehicle security, recovery and incident handling. Only authorised staff can access it, every access is recorded, and data is retained for a limited, configurable period.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can request a copy of your data or its deletion from your account settings, subject to legal retention obligations for contracts, invoices and incidents.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Privacy requests: use the contact form and choose the subject "Other".

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.body: The general terms and conditions governing the use of RideKmer, bookings, payments, deposits, liability and disputes will be published here after legal review.

rentalPolicy.title: Rental policy
rentalPolicy.body: Eligibility (age, licence seniority), kilometre allowances, fuel policy, late-return fees, cleaning fees, cross-border restrictions and incident obligations will be detailed here after legal review.

cancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation policy
cancellationPolicy.body: Free cancellation up to {hours} hours before pickup (placeholder). Later cancellations retain a configurable share of the rental. No-shows are not refunded. Final rules pending legal review.

inspections.estimateHint: Used for the deposit deduction when the damage is new.
inspections.estimatePickupHint: Documented for reference; pickup damages are never charged.
inspections.submitHint: Submission freezes the inspection, updates the vehicle mileage and, for a return, computes the settlement. The customer is then asked to acknowledge it.

settlement.title: Return settlement
settlement.customerHint: The deposit refund is initiated by our finance team after approval; you will be notified.
settlement.hint: Opens the refund request (approval required) and records any additional charge. Can only be done once.

customer.title: Your acknowledgement
customer.hint: Confirm that the inspection reflects the vehicle state, or dispute it with an explanation. Both are recorded with evidence.
customer.acknowledged: Thank you, your acknowledgement is recorded.
customer.disputed: Your dispute is recorded; our team will contact you.

result.PHOTOS_REQUIRED: At least four photos are required.
result.PICKUP_MISSING: A submitted pickup inspection is required before the return.
result.REFUND_ERROR: The refund request could not be created.
result.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The photo could not be saved: file storage is not available right now.

incidents.reportIntro: Accident, damage, breakdown or theft: tell us what happened as soon as possible.
incidents.emergencyBody: Call the emergency services first, then contact RideKmer support. For accidents and theft a police report is required.
incidents.notAllowed: Incidents can be reported during or after the rental.
incidents.descriptionHint: At least 10 characters. Mention other vehicles, injuries and witnesses.
incidents.photosHint: Up to 6 files (JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF).
incidents.blockVehicle: Block the vehicle for 7 days (no new bookings)

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.adjustmentHint: Positive credits the owner, negative debits them. Audited and append-only; reverse with an opposite adjustment.

payouts.title: Owner payouts
payouts.requestForOwner: Request on behalf of an owner

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: CSV exports of bookings, payments, refunds, payouts, expenses, ledger entries and owner statements for a date range. Cells are protected against spreadsheet formula injection and every export is audited.
reports.noExport: Your role can view reports but not export them.
reports.hint: Choose the dates, then download the report you need.

owner.title: Earnings and payouts
owner.intro: Your share of each completed rental, net of commission and allocated expenses.
owner.noPayoutMethod: Add a payout method to request payouts.
owner.noStatements: No statement yet; statements are issued on the 1st of each month.

result.PAYOUT_PENDING_APPROVAL: Approval recorded; a second approver is required.
result.PAYOUT_PAID: Payout paid and posted to the ledger.

fleet.title: Fleet map
fleet.privacyNotice: Vehicles are tracked, never people. Every view of location data is recorded in the access log. Provider: {provider}.
fleet.mapTitle: Last known position of each tracked vehicle
fleet.none: No vehicle has a tracker assigned.

history.reasonNotice: Location history is personal data under the privacy notice. State why you need it; the reason, the range and your identity are logged and visible to auditors.
history.reasonHint: e.g. incident IN-XXXX investigation, theft report, customer dispute
history.enterReason: Enter a reason (at least 5 characters) to load the history.

access.title: Location access log
access.intro: Who looked at which vehicle's location, when, over which range and why. Entries cannot be edited.

devices.title: Tracker devices
devices.intro: Commercial GPS trackers are the live location source. AirTag / SmartTag are recorded as secondary recovery devices only: no live integration, no tracking claim. Owner vehicles need the owner's recorded consent before assignment.
devices.registerHint: Serial and SIM numbers are encrypted at rest and never shown on public pages.
devices.consentHint: Required for owner vehicles; upload the signed consent as a vehicle document.

geofences.title: Geofences
geofences.intro: City zones alert when a vehicle leaves them; restricted zones alert on entry. Geometry is a circle (centre + radius) or a polygon of latitude, longitude pairs.
geofences.name: Name
geofences.ringHint: One 'lat, lng' pair per line, at least 3.

immobilisation.title: Remote immobilisation requests
immobilisation.policyBody: An immobilisation can only be sent when the vehicle is verifiably stationary (recent fix, no speed, ignition off), after a written reason, confirmation by authorised staff and two distinct approvals, and only through a contractually approved provider that acknowledges the command. No provider is configured today: executing a request records the status “Unavailable (no provider)” and nothing is sent to any vehicle.
immobilisation.requestHint: Only vehicles with an assigned tracker can be selected. Use this after a theft report or a serious contractual breach, never for payment pressure.
immobilisation.reasonHint: At least 10 characters; cite the incident or police report reference.

vehicle.title: Telematics
vehicle.ownerNotice: Location data is used for vehicle security and assistance and is only accessible to authorised staff; every access is logged.

result.IMMOB_REQUESTED: Request recorded; confirm the vehicle is stationary next.
result.IMMOB_STATIONARY: Stationary state confirmed from the latest fix.
result.IMMOB_EXECUTE: Executed: see the provider result on the request.
result.INVALID_STATUS: Not possible in the current status.
result.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Owner consent date is required for owner vehicles.
result.DUPLICATE_DEVICE: A device with this provider id already exists.
result.NOT_STATIONARY: The vehicle is not verifiably stationary (needs a fix under 10 minutes old, no speed, ignition off).
result.SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve your own request.
result.ALREADY_DECIDED: You already decided on this request.
result.REASON_REQUIRED: A reason of at least 10 characters is required.
